newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Caracas stocks close ahead, pulled by Electricidad.
newsitem.headline: Caracas stocks close ahead, pulled by Electricidad.

text.p: Caracas stocks closed firm in moderate trade with the index pulled ahead by bellwether Electricdad de Caracas on news it may soon receive a 78 percent tariff rise, traders said.
"The day was lead by stong demand in particular stocks," said Cavelba broker Harold Cuellar, who noted nearly 20 percent of the day's trade volume was in Electricidad.

Sources at Venezuela's Electric Regulatory Commission (CREE) told Reuters Friday it had recommended a 78 percent tariff rise for the company, slowly phased in through the year. A final government decision is still pending on the hike.

Electricidad closed up 7.95 bolivars at 525.95, helping firm the .IBC index 0.18 percent to 6,312.73 points as 22 million shares exchanged hands, worth four billion bolivars ($8.4 million). Merinvest's composite .MRCP index, which includes telephone company CANTV, meanwhile closed off 0.22 percent at 97.21 points.
Among traded stocks, 12 rose, 21 fell and nine closed flat.
No set trend is seen for the coming week, brokers said.
"It all depends on the news, especially on tariff increases," said one.
